keyEvents.text: Goal! Heart of Midlothian 1, Monaco 0. Jordi Altena (Heart of Midlothian) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Sabah Kerjota following a set piece situation.
Goal! Heart of Midlothian 1, Monaco 1. Folarin Balogun (Monaco) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Matthis Abline (Monaco) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Heart of Midlothian 1, Monaco 2. Edan Diop (Monaco) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Folarin Balogun.
Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Heart of Midlothian 2, Monaco 2. Sabah Kerjota (Heart of Midlothian) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner following a set piece situation.
First Half ends, Heart of Midlothian 2, Monaco 2.
Substitution, Heart of Midlothian. Rogers Mato replaces Christian Borchgrevink.
Substitution, Heart of Midlothian. Blair Spittal replaces Matthew Gillies.
Second Half begins Heart of Midlothian 2, Monaco 2.
Christian Mawissa (Monaco) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Monaco. Ilies Belmokhtar replaces Takumi Minamino.
Substitution, Monaco. Flávio Nazinho replaces Vanderson.
Delay in match because of an injury Edan Diop (Monaco).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Monaco. Mathys Detourbet replaces Christian Mawissa.
Substitution, Monaco. Mamadou Coulibaly replaces Edan Diop because of an injury.
Mathys Detourbet (Monaco) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
